origin.source: runSeam over the unmodified email-drafter machine: one addressed model call (emailDrafter #0) runs a candidate while every other request is served from the call plan, scored by plain dependency-free scorers and compared across a good and a bad candidate

comparison.purpose: A whole-run eval says the agent got worse; a seam run says which model call got worse, because runSeam scripts every request except the one under test and returns both its answer and the branch it caused.
